- Do not claim cross-process writer coordination or protection against hostile filesystem mutation.
- Tiered hot/warm/cold body caching is design only. No direct tier-cache implementation.
- Authorized bounded synthetic real-model/MCP verification is complete for V1. Do not infer authorization for further commits (the prior single commit was already created), pushes, data deletion, dependency installs, model-default/.env changes or key/private transcript logging. Preserve unrelated uncommitted work.

- Tests and benchmark scripts were removed at the user's request. Restore the external backup documented in docs/project_cleanup.md before running historical verification commands.
- Never treat historical test results as fresh verification of later changes.

## Definition of Done
- RED then GREEN tests demonstrate input preservation, lifecycle outcomes, request deduplication and cross-Turn task resume.
- For subsequent behavior changes, restore or add the relevant tests and run fresh scoped/full verification. Historical acceptance records remain in docs/.
- Existing full-suite failures must be reproduced with baseline sources and reported; never hide failures or alter unrelated modules to claim green.
- Report acceptance results and distinguish archive/history recovery from live task execution recovery.
- feature_list.json is the source of truth for feature status; evidence must reference actual outputs.
- Structural harness scores are not application runtime performance evidence.

## End of Session

- The user's one authorized Team V1 freeze commit is complete (9138ac1). Preserve remaining dirty files; do not create further commits, amend or push without new instructions. Record actual task evaluations separately.
